Can you recommend books written by Jeremy Frommer and Rick Schwartz that belong to the Art category?

gpt-4o-mini.title: The Art of Collecting: A Guide to Building an Art Collection
gpt-4o-mini.explanation: A comprehensive guide that provides insights into the world of art collecting, suitable for both beginners and experienced collectors.

gpt-4o-mini.title: Omni Magazine February 1980
gpt-4o-mini.explanation: A captivating issue of Omni Magazine from February 1980, featuring thought-provoking articles and stunning visuals that explore the intersection of art and science. This edition, curated by Jeremy Frommer and Rick Schwartz, delves into innovative concepts and creative expression in the art genre.

gpt-4o-mini.title: The Creative's Guide to Starting a Business: How to turn your talent into a career
gpt-4o-mini.explanation: A practical guide for artists looking to monetize their skills and navigate the business side of the art world.

gemma2:9b.title: Drawing on the Right Side of the Brain
gemma2:9b.explanation: A classic guide to unlocking artistic potential through exercises and techniques.

gemma2:9b.title: The Artist's Way: A Spiritual Path to Higher Creativity
gemma2:9b.explanation: A workbook designed to help artists overcome creative blocks and find inspiration.

gemma2:9b.title: Make Your Own Art: A Guide to the Creative Process
gemma2:9b.explanation: Provides practical advice on developing a personal art style and expressing oneself creatively.
